release_notes.headline_internal: ADV state authority: archived changes no longer appear active; stale bundles refused; orphan stores and abandoned workflows cleared
release_notes.headline_external: ADV now reports change status consistently and refuses to serve from stale plugin bundles
highlights: Write-side root cause repaired: archiveChangeSignal now durably records terminal status at signal time (matching every sibling terminal signal), so an archived change can no longer linger as draft when its workflow doesn't exit promptly
Read-side per-ID archive dominance applied to summary rows across list, listSummary, get, snapshot, and launcher — every surface now agrees on terminal status
Cross-surface terminality invariant test locks the agreement at build time

Loaded plugin bundle generation is now the correctness authority: a stale bundle is refused with a typed error and a recovery hint naming the exact process to restart (OpenCode host vs Vision adv-advance MCP server)
Project-identity resolver fails closed on non-40-hex identities; test-mode stores redirect outside the production data home, stopping orphan-store creation at the source
Machine-wide cleanup: 13,035 orphan/malformed identity stores removed, 22 abandoned running workflows cleared, 91 stale summary shards rewritten to archived
Three spec deltas staged as durable law (enumeration terminal dominance, degradation provenance, loaded-bundle identity authority)
release_notes.area: advance-workflow / advance-meta (Temporal state authority, read model, bundle identity)

breaking.description: The archiveChangeSignal handler now performs an additional projection activity at signal time under a new Temporal patch (ARCHIVE_SIGNAL_PERSIST_PATCH). Existing running ADV workflows replay safely (patch-gated). Operators must rebuild and redeploy the worker bundle (build:worker) for the patch to take effect; until then, archived-but-running workflows continue to rely on read-side dominance (which is correct, just not root-caused).
breaking.migration: After merge: rebuild worker (pnpm run build:worker), redeploy, restart the Temporal worker process. Re-run `adv census` and `adv_change_list` in both directions to confirm AC1/AC15 (post-deploy obligations recorded in agreement.md Design Compromise 3).
